page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this server is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff. While multi-core operations, such as stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Passmark CPU tests, and software compilation, score in the average tier, single-core performance is weak, placing in the bottom 25% for Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core tests. Memory bandwidth remains average, with read-only large block speeds reaching 98.84 GB/sec.

Given the high memory capacity of 256.0 GB alongside dedicated CPU cores, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded performance. It is suited for database operations, Redis deployments, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks where memory capacity is the primary bottleneck.
